ModMetaData.name: SpineLib
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
The shared library used by my other mods, published as SpineLib. It adds no gameplay by itself. Install it when another mod requires it.
- Alt-click supported buttons, commands, and labels to open the matching setting - Settings pages with search and a Simple/Advanced split when the page is large enough - Stable tooltips and bounded caching - Guarded Harmony patch installation, attributed to the mod that asked for it
Other modders can use SpineLib in their own mods.
Requires Harmony. Load SpineLib before anything that depends on it. The package ID and internal API identifiers remain CoolNether123.Spine for compatibility.
